scope: Source-only applicability review of existing HC/dense knobs during independent quiet QSA timing. No flag was enabled, no engine compiled, GPU job launched or performance conclusion made.
observations: gr_upmix is implemented only under __HIPCC__; this SYCL compilation takes its explicit false return and the existing separate projection/mix fallback.
bf16_hcd_exact relies on a calibrated HIP/hipBLASLt 1176/1177 path; SYCL returns false. It is not an Intel exact-order implementation.
Default BF16/F16 projections call dpct::blas::gemm with oneMKL transpose and f32 compute descriptors. The names of HIP WMMA flags do not establish Intel implementation or speed.
gr_write_norm_rs explicitly rejects padded rows on SYCL; enabling the existing HC padding flags without a port is not a supported tuning step.
Existing HC shape is N2560,HC4,D10240,LR320 in this actual compiled source; B70 or another hardware result cannot be substituted for its measurement.
next_constraints: A future HC fusion needs an actual SYCL implementation and exact-order/device numerical gates, not only an environment flag.
Machine-specific register/AOT settings may be studied without floating-point reassociation, then logged>=32K checks and clean>=32K comparisons.
